Added option to disable camera bobbing
Lantern charge/stamina bar changed
Small optimization

notes.title: 1.88 Fixes
notes.content:
Slowed down the hardest enemies
 Fixed camera shake when overcoming obstacles and while pulling up
 Stamina recovers faster
 The hero now moves in all directions at the same speed
  The game has become less difficult overall
